;; gen-rdr.toc - GENERATED by interpreter/intrp-emit.toc (do not edit).

(add-ns rdr (module "intrp-rdr.toc"))

(defp parse-then [r f])
(extend-type rdr/ParserMatch (parse-then [r f] (f (.value r) (.state r))))
(extend-type rdr/ParserIgnore (parse-then [r f] r))
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-then [r f] r))

(defp parse-or [r else-f])
(extend-type rdr/ParserMatch (parse-or [r e] r))
(extend-type rdr/ParserIgnore (parse-or [r e] r))
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-or [r e] (e r)))

(defp parse-error-msg [r])
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-error-msg [v] (.msg v)))

(defp parse-error-state [r])
(extend-type rdr/ParserError (parse-error-state [v] (.state v)))


(defn parse-error-line [file out line msg]
  (exit 1 (to-str [out file ":" (number-str line) ":" msg])))
(def fn-alpha)
(def fn-digits)
(def fn-word)
(def fn-entry)
(defn fn-alpha [state]
  (let [input (.input state)
        c (subs input 0 1)]
    (cond (str= c "")
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected end of input" state)
      (and (<= 97 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 122))
      (rdr/ParserMatch c (rdr/take-char state))
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn fn-digits-0-char [c] (and (<= 48 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 57)))
(defn fn-digits-0 [state]
  (let [t (rdr/read-run state fn-digits-0-char)]
    (rdr/ParserMatch (.text t) (.state t))))
(defn fn-digits [state]
  (fn-digits-0 state))
(defn fn-word-0-char [c] (and (<= 97 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 122)))
(defn fn-word-0 [state]
  (let [t (rdr/read-run state fn-word-0-char)]
    (rdr/ParserMatch (.text t) (.state t))))
(defn fn-word [state]
  (fn-word-0 state))
(defn fn-entry-2-0-1-0 [state]
  (let [input (.input state)
        c (subs input 0 1)]
    (cond (str= c "")
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected end of input" state)
      (and (<= 48 (char-code c)) (<= (char-code c) 57))
      (rdr/ParserMatch c (rdr/take-char state))
      (rdr/ParserError "unexpected character" state))))
(defn fn-entry-2-0-1 [state]
  (parse-then (fn-entry-2-0-1-0 state)
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (rdr/ParserMatch [v0] s1))))
(defn fn-entry-2-0 [state]
  (parse-or (fn-alpha state)
            (fn [e1]
              (fn-entry-2-0-1 state))))
(defn fn-entry-2 [state acc]
  (parse-or (parse-then (fn-entry-2-0 state)
                        (fn [v s2]
                          (fn-entry-2 s2 (vect-conj acc v))))
            (fn [e]
              (rdr/ParserMatch acc state))))
(defn fn-entry [state]
  (parse-then (fn-digits state)
              (fn [v0 s1]
                (parse-then (fn-word s1)
                            (fn [v1 s2]
                              (parse-then (fn-entry-2 s2 empty-vector)
                                          (fn [v2 s3]
                                            (parse-then (cond (str-prefix? "!" (.input s3))
                                                              (rdr/ParserMatch "!" (rdr/take-char s3))
                                                              (rdr/ParserError "expected \"!\"" s3))
                                                        (fn [v3 s4]
                                                          (rdr/ParserMatch [v0 v1 v2 v3] s4))))))))))
(defn parse-seq [file state acc]
  (let [s (rdr/skip-whitespace state)]
    (cond (str= (.input s) "")
      (rdr/ParserMatch acc s)
      (parse-or (parse-then (fn-entry s)
                            (fn [v s2]
                              (parse-seq file (rdr/skip-whitespace s2)
                                          (to-str [acc (to-str [v "\n"])]))))
                (fn [e] (parse-error-line file acc
                                          (rdr/state-line (parse-error-state e))
                                          (parse-error-msg e)))))))

(main [argv]
  (let [file (extract (get argv 1))]
    (parse-then (parse-seq file (rdr/make-state (slurp file) file 1) "")
                (fn [out s] (pr* out)))))
